symptoms_en: Young caterpillars eat leaves; grown ones feed on buds, flowers and pods with only the head inside, eating the developing seeds. One caterpillar can destroy 30-40 pods.
symptoms_hi: छोटी इल्लियाँ पत्तियाँ खाती हैं; बड़ी इल्लियाँ कलियाँ, फूल और फलियाँ खाती हैं, केवल सिर अंदर डालकर बन रहे दाने खा जाती हैं। एक इल्ली 30-40 फलियाँ नष्ट कर सकती है।

symptoms_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of black and green gram
symptoms_en.quote: Young larvae - defoliation Grown up larvae feed on buds, flowers and pods. Developing and partly matured seeds are completely eaten by the larvae.

symptoms_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of red gram

management_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of black and green gram
management_en.quote: Sowing three rows of sorghum or maize seed using 250 g/ha around the field. Install Pheromone traps for Helicoverpa armigera @ 12/ha to monitor the population. Light trap @ 1/ha to attract and kill the adult moths. Bird perches @ 50/ha to enable the birds to feed on the larvae.

management_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of red gram
management_en.quote: For pod borers, raise one row of sunflower as intercrop for every 9 rows of pigeon pea and plant maize as border crop.

recipe_slugs.title: NITI Aayog: Empowering Farmers, Natural Farming Training Toolkit and Best Practices Guide
recipe_slugs.quote: Borer, Fall Armyworm, and Fruit Fly control: Spray Agniastra @ 3 litres / 100 litres water
recipe_slugs.note: Natural-farming guide (NITI); the recipe is matched to the pest class, not tested on this crop in Malwa.

recipe_slugs.title: NITI Aayog: Empowering Farmers, Natural Farming Training Toolkit and Best Practices Guide
recipe_slugs.quote: For caterpillars and other insects: Spray Dashparni Ark or Agniastra @ 7.5 litres + 250 litres water
recipe_slugs.note: Natural-farming guide (NITI); the recipe is matched to the pest class, not tested on this crop in Malwa.

management_en: Sow three rows of sorghum or maize around the field as a border. Use pheromone traps (12 per hectare) and a light trap (1 per hectare), and put up bird perches (50 per hectare). In arhar, sow one row of sunflower for every 9 rows.
management_hi: खेत के चारों ओर ज्वार या मक्का की तीन कतारें सीमा-फसल के रूप में बोएँ। फेरोमोन ट्रैप (12 प्रति हेक्टेयर) और लाइट ट्रैप (1 प्रति हेक्टेयर) लगाएँ तथा पक्षियों के बैठने की खूँटियाँ (50 प्रति हेक्टेयर) गाड़ें। अरहर में हर 9 कतार पर सूरजमुखी की 1 कतार बोएँ।
